viewing_check: Check each shade for chips, cracks and rim flea bites, confirm all five are matching, look for a maker's mark or patent number on the cast body (Markel, Virden, Lincoln, Crown), whether it is spelter with lost gilt or reproduction, and the wiring and sockets. Photograph the underside and canopy.
